source: Real extension UI with generated fixtures, mock figure cards, synthetic API responses and an example model catalog. Document, gallery and model captures use 0.8.15; three unchanged feature views reuse labeled 0.8.7 captures. Capture versions, crops and hashes are recorded below; provider speed and accuracy are not measured.
